arc: Grace, a hard-working nurse raised by poor single mother Rosa, gives blood to save wealthy Eleanor Whitmore after an accident – and a routine test reveals Grace is Eleanor's biological daughter. 25 years ago two babies were switched at St. Mary's hospital. Chloe, the daughter who grew up rich, will do anything to keep her place: sabotage, lies, framing Grace for theft. Dr. Nathan Brooks helps Grace uncover who switched the babies – and why. Season plan (8 parts): 1 the blood test and the first humiliation by Chloe; 2 Grace meets the Whitmores, Chloe frames her for stealing a necklace; 3 Rosa reveals she knew something; 4 the hospital record that was erased; 5 Chloe's secret meeting with a nurse from 25 years ago; 6 the DNA party disaster; 7 the truth: Chloe's biological mother planned the switch; 8 Grace chooses both her families, Chloe faces the consequences, Nathan proposes.
